u0: Initial state: the agent has not picked up the key yet and is somewhere on the starting side of the closed door. Progress: nothing acquired or opened. Next objective: locate and pick up the yellow key to advance to u1; if the key is already held this step, move on to opening the door.
u1: Holding the yellow key with the door still closed. Progress: key acquired but the wall is not yet passed. Next objective: navigate to the locked door and toggle it open to reach u2. Keep possession of the key: dropping it now before opening the door triggers the forbidden key_lost event and moves to the failure state u4.
u2: Door is open with the key in hand (or otherwise past the barrier). Progress: the wall's single gap has been unlocked and passed through. Next objective: move toward the bottom-right inner corner and step onto the green goal to finish in u3. Do not relock or loiter; the episode only ends on the goal.
u3: Terminal success state: the agent has stepped onto the goal, episode over. Progress: mission complete with the key kept while the door was closed. Nothing more to do; any further transitions stay in u3.
u4: Terminal failure state: the agent dropped the yellow key while the door was still closed, firing key_lost. Progress: the key is no longer carried and the door remains shut, so the goal is unreachable and the run has been penalized and ended. No recovery action is available.
